descriptions.text: Gnomish Legate Balloon. The Vahana. Contraption. Of all the vehicles left aboard the dreadnaught Wasteland, the Vahana is perhaps the oldest. Once, long ago, the gnomes believed they could avoid war. And while they could not leave this conflict-infested world, they could take to the skies, out of reach of everyone else. They hoped they could set themselves up as neutral peacekeepers. Everyone knew that the black and gold-striped balloons were off limits. The balloons were a symbol of hope. The sight of a Gnomish Legate on the horizon heralded the arrival of ambassadors, and perhaps peace. But when new visitors came to their world, coming via a mysterious portal, everything changed. …

recap.text: Carl climbs into the black and gold striped Vahana with Katia, shaped as the gnome Wynne, and Donut, and watches the pilot to memorise the controls. Donut casts Hole under the floor, and all three gnomes drop through it. Carl yanks the fire pull, fires eight missiles from a multi-launcher, and catches the round balls on Protective Shell. He yells jump, and all three leap before dozens of round balls smash the basket.

beats.headline: Black and gold stripes
beats.text: Thirteen vehicles drop from the Wasteland and circle downward, bombs and rockets on their undersides. In the middle of the formation, a single traditional hot-air balloon keeps descending, black and gold striped and covered in ribbons and small flags, decorated for a parade rather than a war, a shield shimmering round it. Three gnomes look over the edge of its basket: an aerostat pilot, a negotiator and a sniper captain. It crunches into the sand, and Carl reads its properties. The Vahana, a Gnomish Legate Balloon.
beats.gist: Black-and-gold parade balloon descends among thirteen bomb-laden vehicles, carrying three gnomes, and crunches into the sand.

beats.headline: A hole in the basket
beats.text: Carl climbs into the Vahana's wicker basket with Katia, shaped as the stricken gnome Wynne, and Donut, and watches the pilot to memorise the controls as it rises toward the Wasteland. When Langley's rockets go up at the escorts, the sniper Crixus turns them all red. Katia anchors herself with two spikes through the wicker, and Donut casts Hole under the floor. All three gnomes drop through it; Leon catches the edge of the hole and is knocked off by a magical cat paw. After a fight with three rising balloons, Carl moves to the controls.
beats.gist: Carl, Katia and Donut climb into the Vahana, and Donut's Hole spell drops them through its floor.

beats.headline: Abandoned under fire
beats.text: Carl yanks the pull for the fire source and they jerk upward, pushing 500 metres; a farseer is already fixed to the fire controls. A battery on the Wasteland rotates toward the hijacked balloon. He rests a multi-launcher on the basket's edge and fires four missiles, spins the sidewheel, and catches the round balls on Protective Shell. Then he launches the second four and yells jump. All three leap from the wicker basket just as dozens of round balls smash into it.
beats.gist: Carl hijacks the Vahana, fires missiles at a battery's round balls, and all three jump.
